item.title: Pursuit suspect flees into Bell home after high-speed chase
item.description: A high-speed police chase ended in a neighborhood manhunt Thursday after a speeding suspect ditched their car and ran into a home in Bell. item.title: Popular restaurant Duke's Malibu to reopen a year after Palisades Fire
